interpretation: Archival research establishes maintained cereal cultivation and three-field rotation in the medieval Parisis. The estate is a system analogue, not a survey of every game location. Apply the common maintained open-field assessment to existing cultivated land; do not infer hectares or attained yields from population, estate size or buildings.

assignment.range_role: Inferred game assessment, not measured historical development. Test low, central and high with every other assignment fixed.

exclusions: No irrigation bonus or extra crop calendar multiplier.
No additional cultivated hectares or estate-area extrapolation.
No claim that a peaceful frozen-economy control reproduces historical famine, plague or war.
Urban food processing and distribution remain cookery/victuals-market contributions.
